messages:
mike: Heads-up — I'm seeing a sharp saturation spike on the dedicated pool `dedicated-usw2-rtx` starting ~08:10 UTC. Autoscale didn't seem to kick fast enough, requests queued for ~45s. Anyone else? Where do we look for per-pool traces/logs?

anya: yep saw the same. KV cache hit rate dropped and batch sizes spiked for a small subset of requests. Posting the dashboards below.

joel: Grafana link (per-pool): https://grafana.internal/redwood/dedicated-pools?var-pool=dedicated-usw2-rtx
Also Datadog timeseries: `avg:dedicated.pool.saturation{pool:dedicated-usw2-rtx}.rollup(avg,60)` and check `max:inference.request.queue_time{pool:dedicated-usw2-rtx}`

ravi: alert that fired: `dedicated.pool.saturation.high` — currently configured as `>85% for 3m`. Incident bot notification came through at 08:12. Maybe make the alert require sustained >5m to avoid noise.

observability-bot: ALERT: dedicated.pool.saturation.high (pool: dedicated-usw2-rtx) | value=92% | started=2024-11-12T08:11:30Z

mike: thanks. Can someone paste a quick Honeycomb/Jaeger query for traces that hit that pool? Want to see whether specific models / routes caused large KV cache misses.

anya: Jaeger: service=redwood-inference and `tags.pool:dedicated-usw2-rtx` then filter by duration > 200ms. Honeycomb example: `dataset=runtime_traces dataset where pool = "dedicated-usw2-rtx" | group_by(route) | count()`

joel: Quick log query (logql): `{app="inference" pool="dedicated-usw2-rtx"} |= "enqueue" | duration > 200ms`
If you want p95 queue time: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_queue_time_bucket{pool="dedicated-usw2-rtx"}[5m])) by (le))`

ravi: ops suggestion: increase the autoscaler cooldown to 120s for that pool and add a policy that scales on queued requests in addition to GPU saturation. Also capture the current policy config: `kubectl get cm pool-autoscaler-dedicated-usw2 -o yaml` and attach to the ticket.

mike: create a quick issue? I'll triage after breakfast. Assign to eng-sre and include Grafana/Datadog links + copy of alert history.

anya: created issue #4523 (brief description: "usw2 dedicated pool transient saturation - investigate kv-cache and autoscale tuning"). Added links and current alert config.

joel: can someone grab a flamegraph/pprof from one of the affected pods? `curl http://pod-ip:6060/debug/pprof` or use the tooling in the runbook.

mike: grabbing pprof now. If we confirm KV cache pressure, I'll propose a short-term mitigation: temporarily lower batch size on that pool and enable prefix caching for common prompts.

ravi: fine with that for a short window. Also propose adjusting alert to `>90% for 5m` and adding a secondary alert for `queue_time > 300ms for 2m` so we catch user impact instead of transient saturation.

mike: sounds good. I'll update the alert PR after we confirm root cause. Thanks for the quick triage, everyone. :thumbsup:

anya: noted — if you want help with the alert PR ping me, I can review.

observability-bot: NOTE: scheduled autoscaler rollout for pool `dedicated-usw2-rtx` at 09:00 UTC (staged change)

mike: closing the loop here — will post follow-up in the issue with findings and recommended alert changes.
